data.summary: After RF-core-schedule-split, tests/test_plan_pipeline.py::test_a_registered_filter_and_key_take_part_in_the_plan monkeypatches S.FILTERS/KEYS/ORDER on the package, but register_key/register_filter mutate ddflow.core.schedule._filters globals; the test fails on main and leaves late_first in the real ORDER, so tests/test_bugs_first.py then fails in the same process. Patch ddflow.core.schedule._filters instead.

data.summary: test_a_single_adapter_family_has_no_name_and_a_multi_adapter_family_has_one asserts every port except Forge has no name annotation. The Optimizer family has several adapters in a Registry but must omit name from its Protocol to pass; the multi-adapter rule should be derived (e.g. a marker), not a Forge literal.
data.title: tests/test_ports_contract.py hard-codes Forge as the only multi-adapter port, so a second registry family cannot declare name
